description.value:
As a Bonus Action, you can magically empower your bonded familiar for 10 minutes if it is within 60 feet of you. It gains the following benefits for the duration:

  • Your bonded familiar grows to Huge size. If it lacks the room to become Huge, its size does not change.
  • Your bonded familiar's Strength and Constitution score are equal to your spellcasting ability score. If the latter is lower, your bonded familiar's stats do not change. It does not gain any hit points from this increase in Constitution, instead its current and maximum hit points increase by an amount equal to 5 x your Witch level.
  • Your bonded familiar has Advantage on Strength and Constitution Saving Throws.
  • The damage dice gained through the Battle Familiar feature are tripled.

Once you use this feature you cannot use it against until you have finished a Long Rest, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to use it again.
